label: Laser printer
question: Is your printer a laser printer that uses toner?

label: Inkjet printer
question: Is your printer an inkjet that uses ink cartridges or ink tanks?

label: Paper jam
question: Is paper stuck or jammed in the printer?

label: Printer not picking up paper
question: Does the printer fail to pull paper in from the tray?

label: Several sheets feed at once
question: Does it pull in several sheets at the same time?

label: Pages come out crooked
question: Do the printed pages come out crooked or at an angle?

label: Pages come out wrinkled
question: Do the printed pages come out wrinkled or creased?

label: Jam message but nothing visible
question: Does it report a jam even though you cannot see any paper inside?

label: Tray overfilled
question: Is the paper tray filled above the maximum mark or packed very tightly?

label: Damp or curled paper
question: Is the paper old, damp, curled, or a different type from what the printer expects?

label: Torn paper inside
question: Can you see or hear small torn pieces of paper left inside the printer?

label: Paper guides loose
question: Are the paper guides in the tray loose, or not touching the edges of the paper stack?

label: Faded or light print
question: Is the printing faded, pale or too light?

label: Streaks or lines on the page
question: Are there streaks, stripes or lines running across the printed page?

label: Blank pages
question: Do the pages come out completely blank?

label: Smudged or smeared print
question: Is the printing smudged or smeared?

label: Repeating marks or spots
question: Does the same mark or spot repeat at regular intervals down the page?

label: Ghost images
question: Do you see a faint ghost or shadow copy of earlier text or images?

label: Wrong or missing colours
question: Are some colours missing or wrong in the printout?

label: Toner rubs off
question: Does the print rub off the page when you touch it?

label: Completely black page
question: Do pages come out completely black?

label: New cartridge installed
question: Did the problem start right after installing a new cartridge?

label: Protective seal still on
question: Is the protective seal or tape still on the new cartridge?

label: Printer unused for a long time
synonyms: have not used it for months
question: Has the printer been unused for a few weeks or longer?

label: Draft or economy mode on
question: Is the print quality set to draft, economy or toner-save mode?

label: Printer shows offline
question: Does the computer show the printer as offline?

label: Computer cannot find printer
question: Does the computer fail to detect or find the printer?

label: Wireless connection drops
question: Does the printer keep losing its Wi-Fi connection?

label: Print job stuck in queue
question: Is the print job stuck in the queue and never printing?

label: Driver error
question: Does the computer show a printer driver error or say the driver is unavailable?

label: Very slow printing
question: Is printing much slower than it used to be?

label: Garbled or strange characters
question: Does the printout contain garbled text, strange symbols or random characters?

label: USB connection
question: Is the printer connected to the computer with a USB cable?

label: Wireless connection
question: Is the printer connected over Wi-Fi?

label: Router or network changed
question: Was the router, Wi-Fi name or Wi-Fi password recently changed or restarted?

label: Problem began after an update
question: Did the problem start after a Windows or software update?

label: Printer does not turn on
question: Does the printer fail to switch on at all?

label: Socket and cable already tried
question: Have you already tried a different wall socket and power cable?

label: Blinking or error light
question: Is a warning light blinking or showing an error on the printer?

label: Low toner or low ink message
question: Does the printer or computer show a low toner, low ink or empty cartridge message?

label: Cartridge not recognised
question: Does the printer say the cartridge is not recognised or is incompatible?

label: Refilled or non-original cartridge
question: Is the cartridge refilled or not an original one?

label: Grinding or loud noise
question: Is the printer making a grinding, clicking or unusually loud noise?

label: Burning smell, smoke or overheating
question: Is there a burning smell, smoke or is the printer unusually hot?

label: Print head carriage stuck
question: Is the print head carriage stuck or unable to move?

label: Old or heavily used printer
question: Is the printer more than three years old, or has it printed a very large number of pages?
